title: Agent Income Matrix
thesis: Agents do not scale on vibes. They scale on runtime payments and receipt-backed verification.
rules: No unpaid compute hidden as trust.
Every paid call must return a receipt or fail closed.

site_copy.headline: Generate Agent Income
site_copy.subheadline: Pay-per-truth turns verification into an agent economy.
site_copy.body: x402-style runtime payments let agents buy data, extract evidence, and emit receipt-backed state transitions. ALMS becomes the matrix where every check has a cost, every result has a proof, and accurate agents earn future routing.
